chunks: And from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
For a Muslim, whatever Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has decreed is good for him, and if he were to possess the easts and wests of the earth, it would be good for him.
So, Allah protected him from the evil of their plot
Then he said: By Allah, they overpowered him and killed him, but what Allah protected him from was that he would become arrogant or overcome in his faith.

key_terms.يَعْتَوِيَ: To become arrogant or overcome (in faith)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah decrees something for a Muslim even if it seems like a loss?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (a.s.) explains that any divine decree for a Muslim is ultimately good, even if it involves worldly loss or death, as illustrated by the verse regarding Allah protecting a believer from the evil of their enemies' plots. He clarifies that while physical power and death may overcome the believer, Allah protects them from losing their faith or becoming arrogant in it.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 2. It has been narrated that Al-Sadiq (a.s) said
“For a muslim, whatever Allah ﷻ has decreed is good, and if he comes to possess all that is in the East and West,it will be good for him.”
Then, he recited this verse “So, Allah protected him from the evil of their plot” [40:45].
Then he (al-Sadiq) said “By Allah, they overpowered him (i.e. the one intended in the previous Holy Verse) and killed him but what Allah protected him from was being overcome in his faith.”
